---
title: Add Post
description: >-
  Create post updates by uploading cover images, drafting promotional text,
  choosing a post category, and scheduling dates for publication.
---
<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="1374" height="759" style="width: 1374px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

## Step

1. Navigate to Loyalty App > Posts > Add Post.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="265" height="203" style="width: 265px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

- Upload visuals image and banners, enter your title and post details in different language.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="490" height="319" style="width: 490px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

2. Select post categories, pick the start and end dates for your post to appear and click Publish.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="557" height="274" style="width: 557px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />
